original_text: Papers: Man Utd considering move for Arsenal's Lewis-Skelly. The top stories and transfer rumours from Sunday's newspapers...

Warrington go fourth with comprehensive win over Castleford. Warrington Wolves moved up to fourth in the Betfred Super League table after recovering from a lacklustre start to claim a comprehensive 48-18 win at Castleford Tigers .
Everton latest: Toffees interested in Man Utd youngster Wheatley.

Bellingham watches Phoenix seal first Hundred win as Brave stay perfect. Birmingham Phoenix won their first match in The Hundred 2026 women's competition in dramatic fashion, defeating Welsh Fire with just one ball remaining as investor Jude Bellingham watched on.

Crowley to retire from riding and start training. Jim Crowley has called time on his illustrious riding career having failed to recover sufficiently from a serious injury he suffered in a fall at York in September.

'I played like a 10-handicapper!' - Hull fights back to stay in major hunt. Charley Hull is relishing the opportunity to make a late push for major victory after spectacular late third-round fightback at the AIG Women’s Open.

Woad, Hull chase Noh after Ryu blows big AIG Women's Open lead. Yealimi Noh capitalised on Haeran Ryu's stumble to grab the third-round lead at the AIG Women’s Open, where Lottie Woad and Charley Hull stayed in title contention.
